subject: Renewal: term swap, burst capacity request & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightpath.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: term swap, burst capacity request & QBR scheduling

Hi Elena —

Hope you and the BrightPath team are well. We're starting the renewal conversation for your account and want to surface a couple of items up front so we can align timelines and stakeholders: 

- Term swap: you previously mentioned preferring a 12-month commitment vs. the current 24-month term. We can propose a pro-rated amendment; I want to confirm the target effective date.
- Burst/baseline capacity: we saw a sustained increase in peak token throughput in Q3 and BrightPath requested transient burst capacity for the upcoming marketing campaign. We should confirm expected peak TPS and desired burst runway (days/weeks).
- QBR: recommend a short renewal QBR with execs + infra owners to sign off on capacity and terms.

Can you confirm who from BrightPath should join for procurement + engineering? I can coordinate a 60-min slot next week.

Next steps I suggest:
1) BrightPath confirms participants + desired effective term date
2) Redwood shares a redline SOW (I can attach a draft) and an updated usage snapshot
3) Schedule renewal QBR (we'll include legal/procurement if you want them in)

Sharing a tentative window: next Wed/Thu morning (PST). Does either work?

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai]
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: (will attach SOW draft and usage report after internal review)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal: term swap, burst capacity request & QBR scheduling

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up. A few notes from the backend side before we send the SOW: 
- Usage snapshot: I'll export a 90/30/7-day token and peak-per-minute report so procurement has hard numbers.
- Burst options: recommend a 2-week burst window for the campaign with automatic cap rollback; alternative is monthly scheduled burst. We should offer both in the SOW.
- Pricing impact: a shorter (12mo) term with burst runway increases unit pricing ~6-8% relative to the 24mo ladder; include an examples table.

I'll prepare the usage CSV and a draft SOW appendix with burst options. Monica, can you double-check the current committed throughput numbers and whether there are any outstanding credits?

Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

--

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightpath.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightPath Procurement <procurement@brightpath.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 10:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: term swap, burst capacity request & QBR scheduling

Thanks Jordan —

Quick answers from BrightPath side: 
- Procurement will join: Maria Alvarez (maria.alvarez@brightpath.com) + one member from legal if needed.
- Engineering: Elena (me) and our infra lead, Dan Cho (dan.cho@brightpath.com).
- Effective term target: we'd like the amended term to start 2028-01-15 so it aligns with our fiscal planning.
- Burst: we expect a ~3x uplift in token throughput for a 10-day campaign in February; exact TPS still being validated but it will be short-lived.

Please send the draft SOW and the usage snapshot. We'll need the usage export and pricing examples to present to procurement. For the QBR, next Thu morning PST (2027-12-09) works for us — 60 minutes.

Elena
Head of ML Infrastructure, BrightPath Analytics

P.S. Please include any DocuSign link for the amended SOW when you have it.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightpath.com>, Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@brightpath.com>, Dan Cho <dan.cho@brightpath.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: term swap, burst capacity request & QBR scheduling

Thanks Elena — great, appreciate the quick turnaround.

Actions from Redwood: 
- Attached: BrightPath_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW with 12-month term option, burst appendix A with 10- & 14-day runway options) and usage_report_Q3_2027.csv (90/30/7-day breakdown + peak-minute snapshot).
- I'll include pricing tables showing 12mo vs 24mo ladders and the incremental cost for burst windows. Karthik has the technical appendix.
- DocuSign: will circulate redline SOW via DocuSign by Monday after your review.

QBR booking: 2027-12-09 09:00-10:00 PST (60m) — I've sent a calendar invite to the list included. Please accept and add any agenda items; proposed agenda: 1) Executive summary & decision points (10m) 2) Usage trends & peak requirements (15m) 3) SOW term and pricing options (20m) 4) Procurement/legal next steps & timeline (10m) 5) AOB (5m).

If procurement needs a cost center breakdown or PO guidance ahead of the call, let us know and Monica will prepare a short memo.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai]
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: BrightPath_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), usage_report_Q3_2027.csv (text/csv)
